parameters.excerpt: BF16 instructions support all 5 RISC-V Floating-point rounding modes.

parameters.excerpt: The BF16 extensions defined in this specification (i.e., Zfbfmin, Zvfbfmin, and Zvfbfwma) depend on the single-precision floating-point extension F.
